# Search-result delivery rejects an already-cleared adapter scope before dereferencing it

This landing adds the same null-scope entry guard to online and offline AddResultElement before session/folder access. The concrete retirement path calls ClearScope, which closes the stream and clears the raw scope pointer before the session drops its scope list. Both inspected result-delivery callers discard the return value, so the new error does not itself prove surfaced failure or retry. The guard covers an already-cleared pointer; it is not a retained-lifetime or threading guarantee. No tests change and no crash/search/compiler run was performed.

Scope: Native online and offline search adapters.
